summary: Deallocator for a four-slot score/configuration object. Saves this+0x4 and this+0xC, zeroes this+0x0 and both pointers, calls FreeWrapper on the saved buffers when non-null, then zeroes this+0x8 and this+0xC. Returns the result of the final FreeWrapper call (or the saved this+0xC pointer when null).

local_names.this: four-slot score/configuration holder being torn down
local_names.result: saved buffer pointer from this+0xC (also the return value)

operations.description: Save the first buffer pointer from this+0x4 and clear this+0x0 to 0
Only call FreeWrapper on the saved this+0x4 buffer when it is non-null
FreeWrapper_7bcf releases the buffer previously held at this+0x4
Clear this+0x4 and this+0x8 to 0 after releasing the first buffer
Save this+0xC and call FreeWrapper on it only when it is non-null
FreeWrapper_7bcf releases the buffer previously held at this+0xC
Clear this+0xC to 0, completing the zeroing of all four slots

Return the saved this+0xC pointer (or the FreeWrapper result); invoked by sub_42DC00, GearRatioConfigFileReader, TireModelInit, sub_45C400, SeasonDataFileSetupChain, TelemetryDataDump, sub_4E3360 and LargeConfigFunctionWithPhysicsConstants

clean_pseudocode: if (saved3) result = FreeWrapper_7bcf(saved3); else result = saved3;
